title: AuditEnvelope
description: Provenance metadata accompanying every NGS interpretation response. Captures the source vendor report, the engine and schema versions that produced this payload, the knowledge-base versions consulted, mandatory data-source attributions, and a synthetic-vs-production watermark. Required so a clinical reviewer can reproduce the reasoning trail and an auditor can confirm no PHI leakage.

responseId.description: UUIDv4 uniquely identifying this response. Stable across retries; reissued only on a fresh interpretation run.

generatedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when this response was assembled.

engineVersion.description: Semantic version of the UNMIRI NGS interpretation pipeline interpretation pipeline that produced this payload.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this NGS interpretation response schema. Follows the unmiri-ngs-fhir-schema repo's release tag.

vendor.description: Name of the lab or vendor that produced the source report (e.g., 'Foundation Medicine', 'Tempus', 'Caris Life Sciences', 'Guardant Health').

product.description: Specific assay product (e.g., 'FoundationOne CDx', 'Tempus xT', 'Caris MI Profile', 'Guardant360 CDx').

reportId.description: Vendor-issued report identifier (case number, accession, etc). Opaque to UNMIRI.

reportFormat.description: Wire format of the source report ingested by the pipeline.

receivedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the source report was received by the pipeline.

knowledgeBases.description: Versioned snapshots of every knowledge source consulted to produce this response. Required for clinical reproducibility — a recommendation must be reproducible against the exact KB version that emitted it.

refreshedAt.description: When UNMIRI's local mirror of this KB was last refreshed.

watermark.description: Indicates whether this response describes real or synthetic data. The exact synthetic string is required on every example, sample, or pre-pilot artifact and must round-trip unchanged through any rendering pipeline.

dataSources.description: Mandatory attributions inherited from the data-use agreements of any knowledge base that contributed to this response (e.g., AACR Project GENIE citation block, ClinVar attribution).

reasoningTrace.description: Optional ordered list of reasoning steps that produced this response. Useful for clinical-review traceability and for explaining how a CDx flag or trial match was derived. Each step references an upstream variant, biomarker, or KB record.
